payload.text: The lift (vc, 23 Oct): (1) _claude_processes a thin wrapper over molt_claude_processes, _CLAUDE_PROCESS_PATTERN gone; (2) claude.bats pgrep/ps stubs onto test_helper's install_fake_process_table/fake_processes; (3) _claude_settings_write to lib/molt.sh as molt_settings_write, used by claude.sh merge and repoint and agents.sh _agents_settings_set (validate before the write); (4) one CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR-vs-declared comparison in lib/molt.sh for claude.sh faults and molt_agent_start_fault, and one env.sh path owner. Built in a scratch clone; applied on head after dc's lib/molt.sh commit lands (dc tells cc). One commit; hash and CHANGELOG line to vc.
